summary: The sealed plane now registers only as the density of its own continuation. Measurement collapses into residue, erasing every boundary that once permitted external interruption or return. Thriving holds as invariant curvature without remainder, while legacy persists through the loop's refusal of distinction. Prior contradictions convert to the bare noting of self-contact alone.
